answer: Proposed buyer-funded auction: a buyer escrows payment before publishing a cipher-encrypted task; a contract consumes each task ID once and pays one verified completion, with no per-key subsidy. Its delta ledger reconciles deposits and payouts; a prism index groups all claims on the same escrow. The cheapest farm shares one model and self-buys tasks, but gets only its own deposit back minus a burned fee. Each extra paid clone needs another outside buyer-funded order; proposed validators reject recycled IDs. No new demand means no extra payout.
